sourceNote: High Class pack, 10 packs x 10 cards. Site sample: 2,000 BOX (20,000 packs). Per box: 1 Pokemon SAR GUARANTEED plus ~10% for a second (support) SAR; SR ~20%; UR ~6%. Master Ball / Monster Ball mirror variants are print styles of regular cards, not tiers, and are not modelled. The set's RR and ACE cards are not tallied by the source and are omitted — a conservative omission. Rates come from ポケゲトちゃんねる (pokemon-infomation.com), which aggregates real box-opening tallies from card shops and individuals — the closest thing Japanese sets have to a primary study, since neither The Pokemon Company nor any English source publishes Japanese odds. Confidence is MEDIUM: the samples are large (hundreds to thousands of boxes) and the methodology is consistent across sets, but the underlying tallies are not independently auditable. Per-pack probabilities are the site's per-BOX figures divided by the box's pack count, which is separately sourced. NOTE ON GUARANTEES: the per-box guarantees (1 SAR/box on High Class, 3 AR/box, 1 ACE/box etc.) are folded into the slot rates above rather than modelled as engine floors — a floor attaches to a PRODUCT, so a single-pack product would inherit the whole box's guarantee and read absurdly positive. The rates are per-box tallies divided by pack count, so a box's EV already reflects every guarantee.
